## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- Included:
- Explicitly not included:

## Validation

List commands, environments, fixtures, and manual checks used.

## Quality or performance impact

If applicable, include metric definitions, input dimensions, hardware, provider, model hash, sample count, and before/after results.

## Licensing and assets

- [ ] No model weights, datasets, generated media, credentials, or local caches are committed.
- [ ] All fixtures and examples are synthetic, self-created, or explicitly licensed.
- [ ] New third-party material is recorded in `MODEL_LICENSES.md` or `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] Required copyright, attribution, NOTICE, and modification statements are preserved.
- [ ] Not applicable; this change adds no third-party material.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] Commit messages follow `TYPE:English description`.
- [ ] Architecture and dependency direction follow `docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md`.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated in proportion to risk.
- [ ] Pixels outside the final refined mask remain unchanged before lossy encoding, if applicable.
- [ ] Alpha, metadata, audio, and other preserved data are verified, if applicable.
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation are updated separately, if applicable.
- [ ] Experimental or baseline behavior is labeled accurately.
- [ ] Responsible-use boundaries remain intact.
